title: The invoice sits on the payer's Invoices tab, not the customer's
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Invoices tab.
  2. Open customer A's Invoices tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's invoice is listed with Total $210.00 and Balance $210.00.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice is not listed on customer A's tab, so it cannot be paid from customer A's side.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R1: “The invoice's receivable posts to the Bill To's account, on its Invoices tab, AR Aging and statements.”
  • S10-N2: “The customer's own Invoices tab does not list invoices billed to someone else, so they cannot be paid from its side.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
  • Goals: “A shop can invoice a customer other than the one the work is for, without changing the work order's customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Orchard City, Invoices" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build), "A & J, Invoices" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build), "Valders, Open only off" (page 5 "Getting paid", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
